title: Create the synthetic fixture corpus skeleton
description:
Create tests/fixtures/sentiment/ with per-source subtrees (claude-code/, cursor/, codex/) and a README stating the rule: fixtures are synthetic, hand-authored; real transcripts are never committed. Seed each subtree with a minimal example transcript skeleton; fuller fixtures land with each adapter's tasks.

Done when: the skeleton exists, the README rule is stated, and a lint guard placeholder (or TODO reference) exists for the no-real-transcripts rule completed in the privacy epic.
